summary.zh: 以自己的標籤記帳，搜尋完整歷史，從收支、資產與負債回看財務變化。
summary.en: Organise money with your own tags, search your full history, and explore income, spending, assets, and debts.

caption.zh: 展開統計畫面，依日期與標籤查看正項、負項與淨額。
caption.en: Review positive and negative entries, net amounts, dates, and tags on the expanded display.

caption.zh: 從正負方向、日期與標籤建立帳目，也能設定週期帳。
caption.en: Create entries with a direction, date, and tags, including recurring entries.

caption.zh: 收合後以單欄閱讀統計，切換實際資料與含預測的查詢。
caption.en: Read statistics in a compact layout and switch between actual data and queries with forecasts.

notes.zh: iPhone／iPad 1.3，需要 iOS／iPadOS 26.4 或以上。資料預設留在裝置上，無須註冊；可選擇使用自己的 iCloud 帳號進行快照備份及同步。
notes.en: Version 1.3 for iPhone and iPad requires iOS/iPadOS 26.4 or later. Data stays on your device by default, with no registration. Optional snapshots and sync use your own iCloud account.

summary.zh: 拿起來就能寫的安靜筆記本，在裝置上學習你常用的名字與說法。
summary.en: A quiet notebook that learns your usual names and phrasing on device.

summary.zh: 翻開生肖卡片，挑戰記憶力。適合短時間遊玩，也能和孩子一起玩。
summary.en: Flip zodiac cards and test your memory in a quick game, on your own or with children.

summary.zh: 讀四部經典蒙書，聽朗讀，也能走進 Apple Vision Pro 裡的沉浸式蒙館。
summary.en: Read and listen to four Chinese primers, or enter an immersive school on Vision Pro.

summary.zh: 讀《茶經》、探索台灣茶區，從互動製茶認識一杯茶的來歷。
summary.en: Read The Classic of Tea, explore Taiwan’s tea regions, and discover how tea is made.

summary.zh: 用照片、插圖與 3D 模型認識台灣動物，走進沉浸式自然地景。
summary.en: Meet Taiwan’s wildlife through photos, illustrations, 3D models, and an immersive landscape.

notes.zh: 目前可下載 Apple Vision Pro 版本。
notes.en: Currently available for Apple Vision Pro.

summary.zh: 用每週目標、旅程與成就卡片，留下每一趟游泳的進步；記錄成績，回看相對趨勢。
summary.en: Record every swim, revisit relative trends, and celebrate progress through weekly goals, a training journey, and achievement cards.

caption.zh: iPad 旅程：一起查看個人最佳、每週目標與旅程章節。畫面使用示範資料。
caption.en: Journey on iPad brings personal bests, weekly goals, and chapters together. Shown with sample data.

caption.zh: iPhone 成就回放：保留進步時刻，查看比較依據，再預覽分享。畫面使用示範資料。
caption.en: Revisit an achievement on iPhone, inspect the comparison behind it, and preview sharing. Shown with sample data.

summary.zh: 整理孩子的每日任務、成長記錄與家庭約定，讓教養安排更清楚。
summary.en: Bring children’s tasks, growth records, and family agreements into one place.

summary.zh: 把單人家庭演出換成舞台風格影片，修正前景、裁切，保留原音輸出。
summary.en: Give a solo home performance a stage setting, refine the foreground, and export with its sound.

summary.zh: 留一處安靜的修行空間，讀經、記下祈願，也能與他人一起共修。
summary.en: Make space for sutra reading, personal wishes, and shared practice.

summary.zh: 走進寧靜庭院，透過易經儀式、經文與本機記錄，整理一件心事。
summary.en: Enter a quiet courtyard and reflect through an I Ching ritual, readings, and private notes.

summary.zh: 讀懂敵人的攻擊、收集裝備，穿越十二個不該相連的世界。
summary.en: Read enemy attacks, gather equipment, and cross twelve impossible worlds.

notes.zh: Vision Pro 遊戲需要相容控制器。
notes.en: A compatible controller is required for Vision Pro play.

summary.zh: 從地圖與街景探索世界，把有位置的相片帶回曾經走過的地方。
summary.en: Explore maps and street views, then revisit places through your geotagged photos.

summary.zh: 在地圖指揮王國，再看軍隊走上眼前的立體戰爭沙盤。
summary.en: Command kingdoms on a map, then watch armies meet on a spatial battlefield.

summary.zh: 在眼前接線、操作元件，從亮起的 LED 一步步學會控制電路。
summary.en: Wire components in front of you and learn circuit control, one glowing LED at a time.

notes.zh: 前兩課免費；一次性內購解鎖後續四課。
notes.en: Two free lessons; unlock the remaining four with a one-time purchase.

summary.zh: 用注視、捏合與投擲駕馭四種元素，守住逐漸升壓的校園防線。
summary.en: Use gaze, pinch, and throwing to wield four elements and defend an overrun school.

summary.zh: 掃描實體物件，整理成 3D 收藏，在 Vision Pro 打開自己的博物館。
summary.en: Scan real objects, curate a 3D collection, and open your own museum on Vision Pro.

summary.zh: 生成山林、群島與荒漠，保存喜歡的場景版本，在 Vision Pro 走進地景，或匯出模型繼續創作。
summary.en: Generate forests, islands, and deserts. Save favorite scene versions, explore on Vision Pro, or export models for your next project.

caption.zh: Mac：從山林溪谷主題開始，調整植被密度與地形起伏。
caption.en: Mac: start with Forest Valley and adjust vegetation density and terrain relief.

caption.zh: Apple Vision Pro：從桌上模型走進海岸群島的沉浸式地景。
caption.en: Apple Vision Pro: move from a tabletop model into an immersive Coastal Islands landscape.

caption.zh: iPad：嘗試風蝕荒漠，一鍵生成另一個版本，再套用喜歡的調整。
caption.en: iPad: explore Wind-shaped Desert, generate another variation, and apply the changes you like.

caption.zh: Mac：比較保存的場景版本，選擇下一步想繼續創作的地景。
caption.en: Mac: compare saved scene versions and choose the landscape to keep working on.

notes.zh: 1.1 已在 iOS、macOS 與 visionOS 上架。
notes.en: Version 1.1 is available on iOS, macOS, and visionOS.

summary.zh: 用可調整的設定生成立體街景，快速嘗試不同小鎮與建築風格。
summary.en: Generate adjustable 3D streets and explore different towns and architectural styles.

summary.zh: 從四種豪宅風格開始，生成含家具與庭園的住宅，拍下喜歡的光景，或在 Vision Pro 走進空間。
summary.en: Generate furnished homes in four coordinated styles, save photographs, and explore at full scale on Vision Pro.

caption.zh: 在 Mac 調整風格、基地與房間需求，預覽生成的住宅。
caption.en: Adjust the style, site, and rooms in the Mac workspace.

caption.zh: 在 Apple Vision Pro，以真實尺寸探索柱廊入口。
caption.en: Explore a columned entrance at full scale on Apple Vision Pro.

caption.zh: 走進含家具與藝品的房間，切換光景與照明。
caption.en: Step into furnished rooms with artwork and lighting controls.

notes.zh: 1.1 已在 iOS、macOS 與 visionOS 上架。
notes.en: Version 1.1 is available on iOS, macOS, and visionOS.

summary.zh: 從景點、天氣與照片足跡出發，把台灣旅行整理在自己的地圖上。
summary.en: Bring Taiwan attractions, weather, and photo memories together on your personal map.

summary.zh: 把照片做成有文字的貼圖，用名稱與標籤整理收藏，再到 iMessage 分享。
summary.en: Turn photos into stickers with your own text, organise them by name and tag, and share in iMessage.

caption.zh: 在 iPhone Duo 展開畫面製作貼圖，調整文字、顏色與位置。
caption.en: Create a sticker and adjust its text, colour, and position on the expanded iPhone Duo display.

caption.zh: 依名稱或標籤搜尋收藏，並排查看貼圖詳細資料。
caption.en: Search your collection by name or tag and view sticker details alongside the library.

caption.zh: 編輯貼圖名稱與標籤，讓下次找圖更容易。
caption.en: Edit sticker names and tags to make the right reaction easier to find.

notes.zh: iPhone／iPad 1.2.1，持續支援 iOS／iPadOS 26.4。照片去背在裝置上完成；可選擇本機保存或私人 iCloud 同步。
notes.en: Version 1.2.1 for iPhone and iPad continues to support iOS/iPadOS 26.4. Background removal runs on your device; choose local storage or private iCloud sync.

summary.zh: 邊讀注音故事，邊點字查教育部辭典；離線查詞、朗讀陪讀，生成故事不用 API 金鑰。
summary.en: Read Zhuyin stories and tap words for offline Ministry of Education definitions. Create new stories without API key setup.

caption.zh: iPhone 注音閱讀與朗讀控制。
caption.en: Zhuyin reading and playback controls on iPhone (Traditional Chinese interface).

caption.zh: 在 iPad 閱讀時查「森林」，同時查看教育部詞條、注音與解釋。
caption.en: Look up 森林 while reading on iPad, with Ministry of Education pronunciation and definitions (Traditional Chinese interface).

caption.zh: Apple Vision Pro 閱讀器中的詞語查詢，可切換成單字。
caption.en: Look up a contextual word or switch to a single character on Apple Vision Pro (Traditional Chinese interface).

caption.zh: 從生活中的聲音與感官素材開始，選擇故事方向。
caption.en: Start with everyday sounds and sensory prompts to choose a story direction (Traditional Chinese interface).

caption.zh: 在 Apple Vision Pro 分開擺放故事與插圖；畫面顯示 2D 插圖及轉換 3D 的入口。
caption.en: Arrange the reader and illustration separately on Apple Vision Pro; shown in 2D with the 3D conversion control (Traditional Chinese interface).

notes.zh: iOS 1.2 與 visionOS 1.2 已上架。生成故事需支援且已啟用 Apple Intelligence 的裝置與已下載模型；插圖與空間影像依系統支援提供。已儲存故事與內建辭典可離線閱讀及查詢。
notes.en: iOS 1.2 and visionOS 1.2 are available. Story generation requires a supported device with Apple Intelligence enabled and its model downloaded. Illustration and spatial-image features depend on system support. Saved stories and the built-in dictionary are available offline.

summary.zh: 從想說的話開始練英文，用故事複習生字；改用系統模型，無須設定 API 金鑰。
summary.en: Practise what you want to say, then revisit words in stories. System AI, with no API key setup.

caption.zh: 先寫下想表達的意思，再試著用英文說一次。
caption.en: Start with your idea, then try expressing it in English.

caption.zh: 在 iPad 選擇主題，用最近學過的單字生成故事。
caption.en: Choose a theme on iPad and create a story from recent vocabulary.

caption.zh: 查看系統模型狀態與資料處理說明，無須設定 API 金鑰。
caption.en: Check system model availability and data handling, without API key setup.

caption.zh: iPhone Duo 展開時，想法與英文嘗試可並排練習。
caption.en: Practise with your idea and English attempt side by side on the unfolded iPhone Duo.

caption.zh: 在 Apple Vision Pro 的空間視窗中練習英文。
caption.en: Practise English in a spatial window on Apple Vision Pro.

notes.zh: iOS 1.42 / visionOS 1.3。付費下載，無須 API 金鑰、訂閱或 App 內購買。文字生成需支援的裝置、語言、系統設定與已下載的模型；系統生圖及語音功能可能需要網路。
notes.en: iOS 1.42 / visionOS 1.3. Paid download; no API key, subscription, or in-app purchase required. Text generation needs a supported device, language, system settings, and downloaded model. System image and speech features may need internet.

summary.zh: 快速查詢台北蔬菜價格，為採買多一份參考。
summary.en: Look up Taipei vegetable prices for a little more context before shopping.

summary.zh: 整理出缺勤、課堂記錄與聯絡簿草稿，讓教學中的重要細節有處可找。
summary.en: Organise attendance, classroom notes, and draft family updates in one place.

notes.zh: 免費下載，部分功能需訂閱。
notes.en: Free download; some features require a subscription.

summary.zh: 把樂譜、節拍器、調音器與錄音放在一起，為每次練習留下下一步。
summary.en: Keep scores, a metronome, tuner, and recordings together, with a next step for every practice.

summary.zh: 把音樂課的講解與示範記在時間軸上，回家練習時回到關鍵片段。
summary.en: Capture explanations and demonstrations on a timeline, then return to them during practice.

summary.zh: 把演奏或 MIDI 整理成樂譜草稿，連續閱譜、對照原音逐小節修改，再匯出 PDF 或 MIDI。
summary.en: Turn playing or MIDI into a score draft. Read continuously, refine each measure, and export PDF or MIDI.

caption.zh: iPad：連續滑動閱讀整首樂譜，需要修改時再打開單一小節。
caption.en: iPad: scroll through the full score, then open a measure when you want to edit.

caption.zh: iPad：在單小節編輯中調整音符，完成後回到原本的閱譜位置。
caption.en: iPad: refine notes in the measure editor, then return to your reading position.

caption.zh: iPhone：分別選擇原音選段與樂譜合成音，邊聽邊校對。
caption.en: iPhone: choose the original audio selection or synthesized score to compare and refine the draft.

caption.zh: iPad：依用途匯出 PDF、MIDI、HTML、事件文字或作品備份。
caption.en: iPad: export PDF, MIDI, HTML, event text, or a project backup for your next step.

notes.zh: 鋼琴辨識與多音／和弦模式支援最長 5 分鐘錄音；辨識結果是可編輯的草稿。
notes.en: Piano and polyphonic/chord modes support recordings up to 5 minutes. Transcription produces an editable draft.

description.zh: 一起閱讀、練習語言，或動手理解新知。
description.en: Read, practise languages, and learn by doing.

description.zh: 從課堂筆記、日常練習，到樂譜與演出。
description.en: From lesson notes and daily practice to scores and performances.

description.zh: 製作地形、街景與建築，保存你的 3D 收藏。
description.en: Build landscapes, streets, and homes, or curate your 3D collection.

description.zh: 玩一局配對，或走進冒險與戰略世界。
description.en: A quick matching game, an adventure, or a world of strategy.

description.zh: 讀古文、認識茶，也留一點安靜的時間。
description.en: Read the classics, discover tea, and make room for reflection.

description.zh: 找下一站，也重新發現走過的地方。
description.en: Find your next stop and rediscover places you have been.

description.zh: 整理文字、財務、教學與日常的小事。
description.en: Organise writing, finances, teaching, and everyday details.
